say:1:1631825001:1.text: Ah, come on. You're young, you're stubborn, and you have no idea what you're turning down.
say:1:1631825001:1.source_cn: 哎，你还是太年轻，太固执了。
say:1:1631825001:1.male: Ah, come on. You're young, you're stubborn, and you have no idea what you're turning down.
say:1:1631825001:1.female: Ah, come on. You're young, you're stubborn, and you have no idea what you're turning down.

say:2:1631825002:1.text: Do you have any idea how many big names you could meet if you modeled for me? People you wouldn't even dare dream about!
say:2:1631825002:1.source_cn: 你知不知道，当了我的模特，就有机会见到一些大人物，你这...
say:2:1631825002:1.male: Do you have any idea how many big names you could meet if you modeled for me? People you wouldn't even dare dream about!
say:2:1631825002:1.female: Do you have any idea how many big names you could meet if you modeled for me? People you wouldn't even dare dream about!

choice_prompt:3:1631825002.text: Do you have any idea how many big names you could meet if you modeled for me? People you wouldn't even dare dream about!
choice_prompt:3:1631825002.source_cn: 你知不知道，当了我的模特，就有机会见到一些大人物，你这辈子都想不到的大人物！
choice_prompt:3:1631825002.male: Do you have any idea how many big names you could meet if you modeled for me? People you wouldn't even dare dream about!
choice_prompt:3:1631825002.female: Do you have any idea how many big names you could meet if you modeled for me? People you wouldn't even dare dream about!

say:4:1631825003:1.text: If I say the name, you'll faint!
say:4:1631825003:1.source_cn: 那位的名字说出来我都怕吓坏你！
say:4:1631825003:1.male: If I say the name, you'll faint!
say:4:1631825003:1.female: If I say the name, you'll faint!

say:5:1631825004:1.text: Fine. Meowris! Yes, that Meowris. She sat right there while I painted her portrait.
say:5:1631825004:1.source_cn: 喵丽丝！知道吧，在我这儿画过肖像画。
say:5:1631825004:1.male: Fine. Meowris! Yes, that Meowris. She sat right there while I painted her portrait.
say:5:1631825004:1.female: Fine. Meowris! Yes, that Meowris. She sat right there while I painted her portrait.

say:6:1631825005:1.text: I captured every strand of that powerful, glossy fur.
say:6:1631825005:1.source_cn: 我可是画过那位大人柔顺又充满力量感的毛发。
say:6:1631825005:1.male: I captured every strand of that powerful, glossy fur.
say:6:1631825005:1.female: I captured every strand of that powerful, glossy fur.

say:7:1631825006:1.text: Stick around and I'll drop your name. It might open a few doors for you!
say:7:1631825006:1.source_cn: 只要你留下来，我再帮你美言几句，你这家伙就有机会出头啦！
say:7:1631825006:1.male: Stick around and I'll drop your name. It might open a few doors for you!
say:7:1631825006:1.female: Stick around and I'll drop your name. It might open a few doors for you!

choice_prompt:8:1631825006.text: Stick around and I'll drop your name. It might open a few doors for you!
choice_prompt:8:1631825006.source_cn: 只要你留下来，我再帮你美言几句，你这家伙就有机会出头啦！
choice_prompt:8:1631825006.male: Stick around and I'll drop your name. It might open a few doors for you!
choice_prompt:8:1631825006.female: Stick around and I'll drop your name. It might open a few doors for you!

say:9:1631825007:1.text: You have no idea what you're walking away from!
say:9:1631825007:1.source_cn: 你这家伙，怎么这么倔强呢？
say:9:1631825007:1.male: You have no idea what you're walking away from!
say:9:1631825007:1.female: You have no idea what you're walking away from!

say:10:1631825008:1.text: Once Meowris takes over the human world, you'll be swimming in meat!
say:10:1631825008:1.source_cn: 等到喵丽丝大人统一人类世界的时候，你想吃多少肉都有啊！
say:10:1631825008:1.male: Once Meowris takes over the human world, you'll be swimming in meat!
say:10:1631825008:1.female: Once Meowris takes over the human world, you'll be swimming in meat!

say:11:1631825009:1.text: Think about it. Meat every day. Meat without end!
say:11:1631825009:1.source_cn: 你再好好想想吧，那可是吃不完的肉！
say:11:1631825009:1.male: Think about it. Meat every day. Meat without end!
say:11:1631825009:1.female: Think about it. Meat every day. Meat without end!

choice:8:0:1.text: Tempting... but I've got places to prowl.
choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 听起来很诱人……但我得走了
choice:8:0:1.male: Tempting... but I've got places to prowl.
choice:8:0:1.female: Tempting... but I've got places to prowl.
